name: whiteboard-lab
description: A collaborative whiteboard used to test the Workers + Durable Objects model on Cloudflare, celld, and workerd.

scripts.deploy:celld: docker build -q -f deploy/celld/Dockerfile.deploy -t whiteboard-lab-deploy . && docker run --rm --env-file deploy/celld/.env whiteboard-lab-deploy
scripts.rehearse:up: docker compose -p wb-rehearsal -f deploy/celld/compose.yaml -f deploy/celld/compose.local.yaml --env-file deploy/celld/local.env up -d --build
scripts.rehearse:down: docker compose -p wb-rehearsal -f deploy/celld/compose.yaml -f deploy/celld/compose.local.yaml --env-file deploy/celld/local.env down -v
